What Can I Do with Hyperswitch?

 Hyperswitch offers a modular, open-source payments infrastructure designed for flexibility and control. Apart from our Payment Suite offering, this solution allows businesses to pick and integrate only the modules they need on top of their existing payment stack — without unnecessary complexity or vendor lock-in. Each module is independent and purpose-built to optimize different aspects of payment processing.

Learn More About The Payment Modules

- **Cost Observability** Advanced observability tools to audit, monitor, and optimize your payment costs. Detect hidden fees, downgrades, and penalties with self-serve dashboards and actionable insights. _[Read more](https://docs.hyperswitch.io/about-hyperswitch/payments-modules/ai-powered-cost-observability)_ - **Revenue Recovery** Combat passive churn with intelligent retry strategies tuned by card bin, region, method, and more. Provides a unified, secure, and reusable store of customer-linked payment methods. _[Read more](https://docs.hyperswitch.io/about-hyperswitch/payments-modules/vault)_ - **Intelligent Routing** Route each transaction to the PSP with the highest predicted auth rate. Reduce retries, avoid downtime, and minimize latency while maximizing first attempt success. _[Read more](https://docs.hyperswitch.io/about-hyperswitch/payments-modules/intelligent-routing)_ - **Reconciliation** Automate 2-way and 3-way reconciliation with backdated support, staggered scheduling, and customizable outputs. 50: pub async fn make_payout_method_data(
51:     state: &SessionState,
52:     payout_method_data: Option<&api::PayoutMethodData>,
53:     payout_token: Option<&str>,
54:     customer_id: &id_type::CustomerId,
55:     merchant_id: &id_type::MerchantId,
56:     payout_type: Option<api_enums::PayoutType>,
57:     merchant_key_store: &domain::MerchantKeyStore,
58:     payout_data: Option<&mut PayoutData>,
59:     storage_scheme: storage::enums::MerchantStorageScheme,
60: ) -> RouterResult<Option<api::PayoutMethodData>> {
61:     let db = &*state.store;
62:     let hyperswitch_token = if let Some(payout_token) = payout_token {
63:         if payout_token.starts_with("temporary_token_") {
64:             Some(payout_token.to_string())
65:         } else {
66:             let certain_payout_type = payout_type.get_required_value("payout_type")?.to_owned();
67:             let key = format!(
68:                 "pm_token_{}_{}_hyperswitch",
69:                 payout_token,
70:                 api_enums::PaymentMethod::foreign_from(certain_payout_type)
71:             );
72: 
73:             let redis_conn = state
74:                 .store
75:                 .get_redis_conn()
76:                 .change_context(errors::ApiErrorResponse::InternalServerError)
77:                 .attach_printable("Failed to get redis connection")?;
78: 
79:             let hyperswitch_token = redis_conn
80:                 .get_key::<Option<String>>(&key.into())
81:                 .await
82:                 .change_context(errors::ApiErrorResponse::InternalServerError)
83:                 .attach_printable("Failed to fetch the token from redis")?
84:                 .ok_or(error_stack::Report::new(
85:                     errors::ApiErrorResponse::UnprocessableEntity {
86:                         message: "Token is invalid or expired".to_owned(),
87:                     },
88:                 ))?;
89:             let payment_token_data = hyperswitch_token
90:                 .clone()
91:                 .parse_struct("PaymentTokenData")
92:                 .change_context(errors::ApiErrorResponse::InternalServerError)
93:                 .attach_printable("failed to deserialize hyperswitch token data")?;
94: 
95:             let payment_token = match payment_token_data {
96:                 storage::PaymentTokenData::PermanentCard(storage::CardTokenData {
97:                     locker_id,
98:                     token,
99:                     ..
100:                 }) => locker_id.or(Some(token)),
101:                 storage::PaymentTokenData::TemporaryGeneric(storage::GenericTokenData {
102:                     token,
103:                 }) => Some(token),
104:                 _ => None,
105:             };
106:             payment_token.or(Some(payout_token.to_string()))
107:         }
108:     } else {
109:         None
110:     };
111: 
112:     match (
113:         payout_method_data.to_owned(),
114:         hyperswitch_token,
115:         payout_data,
116:     ) {
117:         // Get operation
118:         (None, Some(payout_token), _) => {
119:             if payout_token.starts_with("temporary_token_")
120:                 || payout_type == Some(api_enums::PayoutType::Bank)
121:             {
122:                 let (pm, supplementary_data) = vault::Vault::get_payout_method_data_from_temporary_locker(
123:                     state,
124:                     &payout_token,
125:                     merchant_key_store,
126:                 )
127:                 .await
128:                 .attach_printable(
129:                     "Payout method for given token not found or there was a problem fetching it",
130:                 )?;
131:                 utils::when(
132:                     supplementary_data
133:                         .customer_id
134:                         .ne(&Some(customer_id.to_owned())),
135:                     || {
136:                         Err(errors::ApiErrorResponse::PreconditionFailed { message: "customer associated with payout method and customer passed in payout are not same".into() })
137:                     },
138:                 )?;
139:                 Ok(pm)
140:             } else {
141:                 let resp = cards::get_card_from_locker(
142:                     state,
143:                     customer_id,
144:                     merchant_id,
145:                     payout_token.as_ref(),
146:                 )
147:                 .await
148:                 .attach_printable("Payout method [card] could not be fetched from HS locker")?;
149:                 Ok(Some({
150:                     api::PayoutMethodData::Card(api::CardPayout {
151:                         card_number: resp.card_number,
152:                         expiry_month: resp.card_exp_month,
153:                         expiry_year: resp.card_exp_year,
154:                         card_holder_name: resp.name_on_card,
155:                     })
156:                 }))
157:             }
158:         }
159: 
160:         // Create / Update operation
161:         (Some(payout_method), payout_token, Some(payout_data)) => {
162:             let lookup_key = vault::Vault::store_payout_method_data_in_locker(
163:                 state,
164:                 payout_token.to_owned(),
165:                 payout_method,
166:                 Some(customer_id.to_owned()),
167:                 merchant_key_store,
168:             )
169:             .await?;
170: 
171:             // Update payout_token in payout_attempt table
172:             if payout_token.is_none() {
173:                 let updated_payout_attempt = storage::PayoutAttemptUpdate::PayoutTokenUpdate {
174:                     payout_token: lookup_key,
175:                 };
176:                 payout_data.payout_attempt = db
177:                     .update_payout_attempt(
178:                         &payout_data.payout_attempt,
179:                         updated_payout_attempt,
180:                         &payout_data.payouts,
181:                         storage_scheme,
182:                     )
183:                     .await
184:                     .change_context(errors::ApiErrorResponse::InternalServerError)
185:                     .attach_printable("Error updating token in payout attempt")?;
186:             }
187:             Ok(Some(payout_method.clone()))
188:         }
189: 
190:         // Ignore if nothing is passed
191:         _ => Ok(None),
192:     }
193: }

599:      */
600:     if let Some(existing_pm) = metadata_update {

945: 
946:         let first_connector_choice = connectors

948:             .ok_or(errors::ApiErrorResponse::IncorrectPaymentMethodConfiguration)
949:             .attach_printable("Empty connector list returned")?
950:             .clone();

972:         return Ok(api::ConnectorCallType::Retryable(connector_data));

974: 
975:     // 4. Route connector

Fixed both issues in the payout processing flow.

**Bug 1 - Incomplete card details retrieval for stored payment methods:**

In `crates/router/src/core/payment_methods/cards.rs`, `get_card_details_with_locker_fallback()` only fell back to the locker when `payment_method_data` was completely absent from the DB. When the data *was* present in the DB (as `CardDetailsPaymentMethod`), the `From` impl set `card_number: None` because the DB only stores metadata (last4, expiry, etc.), not the full PAN.

This meant payouts referencing stored payment methods got a `CardDetailFromLocker` with `card_number: None`, causing `get_required_value("card_number")` to fail downstream in the payout validator.

Fix: The function now also falls back to the locker when `card_number.is_none()`, ensuring the complete card details (including the full PAN) are retrieved for processing.

**Bug 2 - Wrong error message for missing expiry year:**

In `crates/router/src/core/payouts/validator.rs` line 246, `expiry_year` was calling `get_required_value("expiry_month")` instead of `get_required_value("expiry_year")`. This caused the API to report `"expiry_month"` as the missing field when actually the `expiry_year` was missing.

Fix: Changed the field name from `"expiry_month"` to `"expiry_year"`.
